meta.name: amazon-listing-competitor-analysis-skill
meta.description: This skill helps users analyze Amazon competitor listings by ASIN and produce structured competitive intelligence plus strategic opportunity points for their own go-to-market. The Agent should proactively apply this skill when users want to analyze a competitor Amazon listing by ASIN, understand what a top-ranked product does right in content keywords or visuals, find market gaps and unmet buyer needs, turn competitor research into opportunity maps for their brand, identify keyword placement patterns on rival listings, extract SEO insights from Amazon product pages, reverse-engineer competitor bullet and title strategies, mine competitor reviews for buyer psychology, compare seller and A plus content patterns, run gap analysis before launching a new SKU, research why a listing wins conversion signals, synthesize whitespace you can own versus the diagnosed listing, or say just look at this ASIN with a competitive or optimization angle.

copy.tagline: 分析亚马逊竞品Listing，提炼市场机会
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在亚马逊上卖货，想通过分析竞品找到增长点。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze Amazon competitor listings and uncover market opportunities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you sell on Amazon and want to find growth opportunities by analyzing competitors.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能分析亚马逊竞品 ASIN，提取标题、要点、图片、评论等数据，并输出竞品优势、市场缺口和你的战略机会点。
howto.when: 当你要求分析某个亚马逊竞品 ASIN，或想了解头部产品的关键词、视觉策略、买家需求缺口时触发。

say.note: Claude 会提取该产品页面数据并生成竞品报告。

say.text: 看看这个竞品的关键词布局和视觉策略
say.note: Claude 会分析标题、要点、图片等并指出机会。

say.text: 帮我找这个 ASIN 的买家未满足需求
say.note: Claude 会从评论中挖掘痛点并给出建议。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can analyze a competitor Amazon listing by ASIN, extract title, bullets, images, reviews, etc., and output competitor strengths, market gaps, and your strategic opportunity points.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to analyze a competitor Amazon ASIN, or want to understand top product's keywords, visual strategy, or buyer needs gaps.

say_en.note: Claude will extract listing data and generate a competitive report.

say_en.text: Check this competitor's keyword placement and visual strategy
say_en.note: Claude will analyze title, bullets, images, etc., and point out opportunities.

say_en.text: Find unmet buyer needs for this ASIN
say_en.note: Claude will mine reviews for pain points and give suggestions.
